card.text: Kepler-93 b crosses Kepler-93 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.

sources.label: Bonomo et al. (2023), Astronomy & Astrophysics 677 A33

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-93b"
sources.quote: Kepler-93b (KOI-69b) is a hot, dense transiting Super-Earth exoplanet located approximately 313 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra, orbiting the G-type star Kepler-93.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Bonomo et al. 2023.

sources.quote: Its discovery was announced in February 2014 by American astronomer Geoffrey Marcy and his team.
